🫧 BubblePop

Bubbles float upward and you must pop them before they reach the top and escape. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click or tap on bubbles to pop them.
  2. Pop bubbles before they float off the top of the screen.
  3. Rapid consecutive pops build a combo — earn bonus points.
  4. Different sized bubbles may be worth different points.
  5. The number of bubbles increases as the game progresses.
